svg.title: Act within your authority.
svg.desc: Ordinary authorised work proceeds to execution and qualification. Reserved human decisions may approve within scope, return to proposal, or reject and stop; approval never substitutes for execution. System model: Act within the authority you have.. Observe Event · schedule Safe production read. Propose Draft · issue Changeset. Check authority. Yes / execute Qualify the bounded result. Reserved human decision Accounts · money · rights Irreversible actions and explicit gates. Reject Record and stop. MP is not the default decision engine for routine authorised work. Approval, return and rejection have different outcomes.
